name: ignored_return_value
description: Helper function return value is dropped by caller rather than incorporated into result.
diagnostic_clue: Function call on a line by itself inside an if-block or calculation sequence without variable assignment.
remedy: Assign helper return value to variable and subtract/apply to final returned total.

name: off_by_one_boundary
description: Upper or lower bound in range or slice is shifted by 1.
diagnostic_clue: Items array missing final element or throwing IndexError on exact page sizes.
remedy: Adjust slice upper bound from len-1 to len or start+size.

name: mutable_default_argument
description: Default list/dict parameter persists mutations across invocations.
diagnostic_clue: Second call retains items added in first call when default argument is used.
remedy: Use None as default and instantiate fresh container inside function body.
